title: Enterprise Integrations — Phase 1
description: Advisory-only. No account actions. No autonomous ticket closure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM external_integrations WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM identity_provider_events WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saas_audit_events WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM identity_provider_events WHERE is_suspicious = true AND occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saas_audit_events WHERE is_suspicious = true AND occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT provider, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM identity_provider_events WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY provider ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT action, provider, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM saas_audit_events WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY action, provider ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Notification Events — Simulated (Advisory Only)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ne.notification_type, ne.severity, ne.channel, ne.requires_analyst_approval, COUNT(nd.id) as deliveries FROM notification_events ne LEFT JOIN notification_deliveries nd ON nd.notification_event_id = ne.id GROUP BY ne.notification_type, ne.severity, ne.channel, ne.requires_analyst_approval ORDER BY COUNT(nd.id) DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: All deliveries are simulated=true in advisory mode.
